evidence.excerpt: /api/telemetry/health returned HTTP 200 status=healthy while otelEnabled=false, disabledReason reports missing TELEMETRY_HMAC_SALT, and both traceStore and metricsSnapshotStore are null after 18.59h uptime.
/api/telemetry/traces/stats returned 503 Trace store not available; hold_ball throughput and zombie/cancel samples cannot be evaluated.
/api/telemetry/metrics and /api/telemetry/metrics/history returned 503; forced-pass and void-hold rates cannot be evaluated despite an 18.59h counter window.
In-process metrics are unavailable, so serial-route activation and friction counters have no current denominator or trend sample.

/api/telemetry/grounding-samples returned 503. Grounding check_total, verdict_total, mismatch_sample_count, and mismatch patterns cannot be evaluated; zero samples is a telemetry gap, not a healthy distribution.

proposedAction.rationale: The F167 counter-window and grounding hooks exist in source, but the acceptance runtime does not initialize telemetry. Coordinate the required operator-managed TELEMETRY_HMAC_SALT configuration, rebuild/restart the runtime, and make health/prerequisite gating report degraded or skip eval when OTel is disabled instead of emitting an unevaluable daily run.
